crop.notes: The ad's top banner 'THE GLORIOUS FOURTH' is cut off; the rest of the ad is complete.

ocr.notes: Two-column ad read across columns; key names and details readable.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat carried an ad for a Fourth of July athletic tournament at the Union Base Ball Grounds, where ex-champions Tom Allen and Tom Kelly would spar the wind-up.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Thursday Morning, July 3, 1884.

facts.fact: Allen and Tom Kelly, billed as ex-champion pugilists of the world, were advertised to spar the wind-up of a Fourth of July athletic tournament at the Union Base Ball Grounds, Cass and Jefferson avenues, St. Louis
places: Union Base Ball Grounds, Cass and Jefferson Avenues, St. Louis
